summary: 14 selected items reviewed for cycle 1. The set is heavily weighted toward OpenAI (three OpenAI-authored launches plus OpenAI president gdb), creating a voice/product cluster where the Codex-voice launch and gdb's voice observation cover the same theme from distinct angles. Several high-impact claims rest on low-reach single-source or secondhand tweets with weak verifiability (Hassabis 'duct tape' at 67 views, Amodei taxation quote at 532 views, the Anthropic math-classifier claim, and a secondhand Musk quote via coinbureau), flagging source-traceability gaps. No hard duplicates warrant removal; the set passes with author-balance and traceability flags noted. Reserve pool is thin (3 general items) and none are strong topical replacements, so no swaps are made.
